location: en route over Senegal; 737 continued to Malabo
accident_class: mid-air collision / fatal accident through fatalities on other aircraft involved
source_publisher: Bureau d'Enquête et d'Analyse pour la sécurité de l'aviation civile du Sénégal (BEA Sénégal) / Ministère du Tourisme et des Transports Aériens
source_record_id: Rapport final — accident du 05/09/2015 entre B737-800 3C-LLY et HS125-700A 6V-AIM
decision_reason: The Senegal final investigation report identifies the accident as the collision between CEIBA Boeing 737-8FB 3C-LLY, serial 41157, and HS125-700A 6V-AIM. The 737 occupants survived; seven persons on the other aircraft died. Boeing's contemporaneous worldwide commercial-jet methodology explicitly treats fatalities on other aircraft involved as external fatalities and lists CEIBA as a fatal 2015 accident with seven external fatalities.

reconciliation_evidence.record: 2015 Statistical Summary / 2015 Airplane Accidents / CEIBA Intercontinental 737-800
reconciliation_evidence.observation: Boeing's worldwide commercial-jet table lists CEIBA 737-800 on 5 September 2015 as a scheduled passenger mid-air collision and records seven external fatalities; its definitions explicitly include fatalities on other aircraft involved as external fatalities.

IATA states that its fatality metric focuses on people onboard the accident aircraft and does not count ground or other-aircraft fatalities, explaining why its zero-fatal-jet statistic cannot by itself discover CEL071 under BSFM's external-fatality-aware target.
